headline: Io updates since Beta 0.8
intro: A summary of the Io changes since Beta 0.8:
notes: Kernel: Linux 7.3.3 with Valve's Steam Deck patches (linux-neptune-73), the display setting amdgpu.dcdebugmask=0x60000 as on SteamOS.
Boot: no more hang at the boot logo (SDDM waits for elogind). The Io logo at boot, the animated Io Torus during firmware updates.
Patch notes: Io's own notes in Steam's SteamOS update page (this page).
Desktop: Steam shares the screen without a prompt; text from Steam's on-screen keyboard arrives correctly (Xwayland 24.1.14).
Screen reader: Orca with Valve's patches keeps running when speech settings change.
Wi-Fi: NetworkManager with Valve's ARP fix.
Power: shutdown and reboot from the power menu no longer crash elogind; hibernation stays off, as on SteamOS.
Storage: SD cards are rescanned through Valve's helper; clearer error messages from the SD card and format tools.
Graphics and audio: Mesa 26.2.6, gamescope-wsi 3.17.0, steamdeck-dsp 1.03.
